svg.title: Anna — private ai · local
svg.desc: An AI companion that never leaves the PC. Runs entirely through Ollama with local retrieval. Reads only approved folders, remembers only what is allowed, and suggests drafts to review. Built with Node.js, Ollama, RAG, Embeddings. Private local AI · hosted on Joshua’s PC.
